story.iWant: to create shortcuts to my favorite sources
story.soThat: I can access frequently-checked sources with one click
story.tasks: - Store shortcuts in browser localStorage - Format: {shortcuts: [{id, name, domain, source_filter, order}]} - Create Shortcuts component in dashboard layout - Use dash-bootstrap-components Offcanvas or sidebar - Support drag-and-drop reordering using dash-sortable or custom JS - Add "Add to Shortcuts" button on content items

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - Given I'm viewing any content item, when I click "Add to Shortcuts" on a source, then the source is added to my shortcuts list - When I view the dashboard, then I see a "Shortcuts" section in the sidebar/header - And shortcuts are grouped by domain (Papers, News, Deals, etc.) - When I click a shortcut, then I navigate to that domain tab with source filter pre-applied - And I can reorder shortcuts via drag-and-drop - And I can remove shortcuts

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Primary Success Metrics include Daily Usage & Indispensability - You stop checking individual sources (HackerNews, Reddit, ArXiv, etc.) directly because Megalith has it all. Colleague Adoption: 3-5 tech-savvy colleagues actively use Megalith for their intelligence needs.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Dashboard Framework: Dash 2.x with Bootstrap components, UI Components: Bootstrap 5 with dash-bootstrap-components 1.x. Responsive design with fluid containers and mobile-ready layouts.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Create Shortcuts component in dashboard layout, Use dash-bootstrap-components Offcanvas or sidebar, Support drag-and-drop reordering using dash-sortable or custom JS, Format: {shortcuts: [{id, name, domain, source_filter, order}]}

doc.title: Story 2.1 Context
doc.snippet: Builds on existing filter patterns from Story 2.1, uses localStorage API for client-side storage integration

artifact.reason: Main dashboard structure where Shortcuts sidebar/offcanvas component needs to be integrated
Deal tab where shortcut functionality will help users quickly access favorite deal sources
News tab components where users will want to create shortcuts to frequently-checked news sources

ecosystem.name: javascript
ecosystem.packages: localStorage API, HTML5 Drag & Drop API, SortableJS library, CSS transitions

constraints.constraint: Store shortcuts in browser localStorage with automatic cleanup of invalid entries
Shortcuts sidebar must use consistent Bootstrap styling and responsive design
Drag-and-drop must be smooth with visual feedback during reordering
Click shortcut must navigate to correct tab and apply source filter instantly (<500ms)
All shortcut interactions must be keyboard accessible with proper ARIA labels

interface.name: ShortcutsManager
interface.signature: class ShortcutsManager: addShortcut(source), removeShortcut(id), reorderShortcuts(order), getShortcuts()

interface.name: AddShortcutButton
interface.signature: dbc.Button(id='add-shortcut-btn', children=[html.I('fas fa-star'), ' Add to Shortcuts'], size='sm')

tests.standards: UI testing using Playwright for drag-and-drop interactions and shortcut management. localStorage testing for data persistence and recovery. Cross-browser compatibility for drag-and-drop functionality. Performance testing for shortcut application and navigation speed.

ideas.idea: Test: View content item, click "Add to Shortcuts", and verify source appears in shortcuts sidebar
Test: Verify shortcuts are grouped by domain (Papers, News, Deals, etc.) with proper categorization
Test: Click shortcut and verify navigation to correct tab with source filter pre-applied
Test: Drag and drop shortcuts to reorder them, verify order persists after page refresh
Test: Remove shortcut and verify it disappears from sidebar and localStorage
Test: Navigate shortcuts using keyboard only, verify proper ARIA labels and focus management
